historical_record.description: A permit was sought for a six-storey reinforced concrete apartment building with a basement, estimated at $47,500.

In the Redevelopment Agency's 1962 acquisition appraisal for Western Addition A-2, the appraiser Maury Holmes put the market value of the property at $245,000 and rated it in good condition. He described a seven-story reinforced-concrete apartment building with a garage, a three-room and a two-room apartment on the street floor and six two-room apartments on each of the other six floors.
